questions.question: Ramaraj Mundukal, a trusted name in traditional men’s wear (especially dhotis/mundus), has been serving South Indian customers for decades. Traditionally, sales relied on word-of-mouth, retail stores, and festival shopping seasons. With changing lifestyles and competition from / [CO2, CO5] branded apparel like Peter England, Ramraj Cotton shifted to digital and social media marketing to reach both traditional and modern audiences. Digital & Social Media Strategies: Social media presence (Facebook, Instagram, You Tube) promoting mundus, shirts, innerwear, and combos with catchy visuals. Festive campaigns: Onam, Pongal, Vishu, and weddings promoted through reels, short videos, and celebrity endorsements. Storytelling ads: Campaigns like “Tradition with Pride” highlight cultural identity, purity of cotton, and craftsmanship.Influencer & celebrity marketing: Popular actors (like Vijay Sethupathi, Vishal, etc.) featured in digital ads to connect with youth. E-commerce & digital ads: Products sold online via their website, Flipkart, and Amazon; boosted with targeted Google/Instagram ads. Engaging younger audiences: Modern styled mundus, combo packs, and styling reels showing how traditional attire can blend with contemporary fashion. Through these efforts, Ramaraj Mundukal successfully repositioned a traditional attire into a stylish, youthful, and culturally significant product, competing strongly against both local weavers and global clothing brands. You are required to:

questions.question: Dettol, a trusted hygiene brand, has effectively used content strategy to strengthen its market position. During the COVID-19 pandemic, Dettol launched the “Hand Wash Challenge” on Tik Tok, teaching people proper handwashing steps in an engaging way. The campaign reached millions of users, especially youth, and combined education with entertainment. In addition, Dettol carried out cause-related campaigns, such as distributing free hygiene kits with government and NGO support, which reinforced its image as a socially responsible brand. / [CO2, CO5] Through localized and multilingual campaigns, Dettol connected with both urban and rural consumers. Emotional storytelling in campaigns like “Protect What You Love” helped position the brand as a protector of families, not just a soap or disinfectant. Dettol’s content strategy shows how a brand can successfully blend awareness, digital engagement, and social responsibility while maintaining strong consumer trust. You are required to point out/analyse:
questions.solution_html:
• 1. What was the main objective of Dettol’s “Hand Wash Challenge” on TikTok?
